description: Stenner's Classic Series is a peristaltic metering pump: the chemical moves through a replaceable tube squeezed by rollers, so it never touches the pump mechanism and the pump can run dry or handle off-gassing bleach without losing prime. Output is set on an external dial from 5 to 100 percent, and tubes and heads swap between models without tools. It is a dependable, low-maintenance choice for hypochlorite and acid feed at small and mid-size pools.

description: The EasyCarb 750 (Pool) is a permanently installed, low-pressure bulk CO2 cylinder that replaces banks of high-pressure gas cylinders for pool pH control. It holds about 789 lb of liquid CO2, delivers roughly 20 lb/hr of gas, and is filled in place by the gas supplier. Paired with a CO2 feeder and chemistry controller it lets a facility reduce or eliminate muriatic acid handling.
